registration_time_basis: Initial amendment file modification time, recorded before new smoke or formal navigation outcomes
reason: Measured first Bayes-Mean IL epoch took 394.85 seconds with three workers. A sequential second 50-epoch IL block would exceed the eight-hour startup budget. Local host has only 8.4 GiB available RAM and 3.9 GiB used swap.
timing_basis: IL compute only; registered before any new navigation smoke or formal outcome
preserved: all environment, reward, action, observation and safety contracts
initialization: Reuse each arm's newly trained seed42 50-epoch IL checkpoint for both formal RL seeds. Do not reuse smoke RL weights, old incompatible Bayes IL, partial IL or selectively chosen navigation checkpoints.
claim_boundary: Two matched online RL seeds with a shared per-arm IL initialization. Not two independent full IL+RL initialization seeds, and not paper-level confirmation.
operator_plan: Preserve the current seed42 IL and its smoke to completion. Retire the old controller before undertaking a second full IL block; preserve any already-started seed43 preprocessing as budget-aborted engineering work. Freeze a formal-only version before launching six RL workers.
formal_requires: All three full 50-epoch seed42 IL jobs and all three 200-episode smoke jobs accepted using their original gates. No gate relaxed.
